display.purpose: Artist name, artwork titles, observations, biography, and monograph chapter statements.

body.purpose: Supporting explanatory copy and metadata values using the system sans stack.

technical.purpose: Navigation, archive codes, captions, labels, controls, and state.

motion.name: interaction
motion.purpose: Links, actions, hover, and focus-adjacent color changes.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Disable smooth scrolling and reduce transitions/animations to near zero.

breakpoints.name: mobile-stack
breakpoints.behavior: 4rem top rail; stacked hero and selected families; archive 2 columns.

breakpoints.name: single-column
breakpoints.behavior: One-column archive, hero counts, and compact action layout.

accessibility.modal: role=dialog, aria-modal=true, focus trap, Escape close, restore prior focus
accessibility.images: factual title-and-view alt text until richer catalogue descriptions are supplied

components.name: Archive Rail
components.description: Sticky narrow index rail on desktop; 4rem sticky top bar below 800px.

components.name: Viewport Hero
components.description: Viewport-bound 12-column opening with Jacques Fuller, Ship of Fools, and the lead record/action.

components.name: Selected Work
components.description: One of six reversible selected records using platform, offset, or study composition families; not alternating rows.

components.name: Archive Card
components.description: Borderless complete-archive button with contained 4:5 image, archive number, title, and view count.

components.name: Living Archive Chapter
components.description: Deep oxide Voice, Studio, and Record paths plus honestly captioned existing detail studies.

components.name: Artwork Viewer
components.description: Full-screen oxide dialog opening on a 75/25 identity rail/image stage, with labelled thumbnails, keyboard controls, paper record, and work navigation.

components.name: Metadata Record
components.description: Labelled fact rows showing source-confirmed values or the exact placeholder Not recorded.
components.css: .viewer__facts div { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1.7fr; border-top:1px solid var(--oxide-line); }

components.name: Catalogue Action
components.description: Patina-green square action used to open a photographic record; all interactive targets are at least 44px.

narrative.overview: A sculpture-led living archive: cold smoke-grey and mineral surfaces, deep green-black oxide chapters, Petrona Variable display, Fira Sans Condensed technical labels, square geometry, and contained photographic evidence.
narrative.contentTruth: The shipped preview contains 24 records and 187 photographs. Six selected works are temporary and reversible. Known facts come only from source folder records; missing material, dimensions, dates, availability, stories, provenance, workshop evidence, and interpretations remain unrecorded.

rules.name: Natural Brass Rule
rules.body: Brass stays in the photography; never use gold or brass as UI styling.

rules.name: Reversible Selection Rule
rules.body: The selected six are temporary curation, never a permanent ranking.

rules.name: Containment Rule
rules.body: Full sculptures use object-fit: contain and are not cropped to decorative frames.

rules.name: Honest Archive Rule
rules.body: Use Not recorded for absent facts and never invent workshop evidence, symbolism, provenance, or artist testimony.

dos: Preserve complete sculptures with object-fit: contain.
Use minimum 44px targets and visible focus states.
Respect reduced motion and modal keyboard behavior.
Label existing detail photography as existing photographic detail.
donts: Don't use black-and-gold or cobalt styling.
Don't round cards, buttons, thumbnails, or metadata into pills.
Don't infer dates, materials, dimensions, availability, provenance, symbolism, or workshop evidence.
Don't present sculpture details as workshop photographs.
Don't add motion that delays access to the photographs.
